_note: Chapter 09 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: He spent a year abroad, studying at a small university in the north.
ex.cn: 他在国外待了一年，在北方一所小学校读书。
ex.note: go abroad 出国；study abroad 留学

ex.en: The report gives an accurate account of what happened that night.
ex.cn: 这份报告准确记录了那天夜里发生的事。
ex.note: an accurate description/record 精确的描述/记录；be accurate to 精确到

ex.en: It took him a week to adjust to the cold water in the harbour.
ex.cn: 他花了一个星期才适应港口冰冷的海水。
ex.note: adjust to 适应；adjust oneself to 使自己适应

ex.en: They bought the equipment from a sports agency near the bus station.
ex.cn: 他们在汽车站附近的一家体育用品经销处买了器材。
ex.note: travel/advertising agency 旅行/广告代理公司

ex.en: She had already packed the boxes before the truck arrived.
ex.cn: 卡车还没到，她已经把箱子打好了包。

ex.en: The customer was angry about the camera he had paid for and found broken.
ex.cn: 那个顾客为自己付过钱却发现坏掉的相机而生气。
ex.note: be angry with/at 对…发火；angry about 因…而生气

ex.en: Her sudden appearance at the door surprised everyone in the room.
ex.cn: 她突然出现在门口，屋里的人都吃了一惊。
ex.note: the appearance of … …的出现；on appearance 乍看起来

ex.en: The children sat around the table and ate the cake.
ex.cn: 孩子们围坐在桌旁吃蛋糕。
ex.note: around here 在这附近；around midnight 午夜前后

ex.en: The students' association organized a concert for the new term.
ex.cn: 学生协会为新学期组织了一场音乐会。
ex.note: in association with 与…合作/联合

ex.en: She drove an old auto to the market every Saturday morning.
ex.cn: 她每周六早上开着一辆旧汽车去市场。
ex.note: auto = automobile 汽车（美式旧称）

ex.en: The children tied a balloon to the leg of her desk chair.
ex.cn: 孩子们把一个气球系在她的办公椅腿上。
ex.note: a hot-air balloon 热气球；a balloon flight 乘热气球飞行

ex.en: The recorder kept dying because its battery was almost used up.
ex.cn: 录音机总没电，因为电池快用完了。
ex.note: a battery of batteries 一组电池；run out of battery 电池耗尽

ex.en: It was his belief that hard work would carry him through the year.
ex.cn: 他相信只要努力，就能撑过这一年。
ex.note: a belief that … 相信……；contrary to popular belief 与普遍的看法相反

ex.en: She gave birth to a healthy baby in early April.
ex.cn: 她四月初生下一个健康的婴儿。
ex.note: give birth to 生育；the birth of … …的诞生

ex.en: It was a bold decision to hold the meeting so early in the year.
ex.cn: 把会议安排在年初这么早，是个大胆的决定。
ex.note: bold print 粗体；a bold move 大胆的举动

ex.en: This brand of tea is sold in every supermarket in the city.
ex.cn: 这个品牌的茶在城里每家超市都有卖。
ex.note: brand name 品牌名称

ex.en: The farmer branded his young cattle with the name of the farm.
ex.cn: 农夫在年幼的牛身上烙上了农场的名字。
ex.note: brand sb./sth. as … 把…污蔑为…；be branded with 被打上烙印

ex.en: The bulb in the desk lamp burned out in the middle of the night.
ex.cn: 台灯的灯泡在半夜烧坏了。
ex.note: a light bulb 灯泡；a tulip bulb 郁金香的球茎

ex.en: He used a calculator to work out the total cost.
ex.cn: 他用计算器算出了总成本。
ex.note: pocket calculator 袖珍计算器

ex.en: A cargo ship was unloading at the far end of the port.
ex.cn: 一艘货船正在港口的另一端卸货。
ex.note: cargo hold 货舱；cargo ship 货船

ex.en: The battery in the recorder is made of three separate cells.
ex.cn: 录音机里的电池由三节单独的电池芯组成。
ex.note: a prison cell 牢房；a cell phone 手机

ex.en: The dog chased the thief across the square and caught his sleeve.
ex.cn: 那只狗追着小偷穿过广场，咬住了他的袖子。
ex.note: chase after 追赶；a wild goose chase 白费力气

ex.en: He chopped the onions into small pieces before the soup began to boil.
ex.cn: 汤还没开锅之前，他先把洋葱切成了小块。
ex.note: chop up 切碎；chop down 砍倒

ex.en: We ordered pork chops and green salad for dinner.
ex.cn: 我们晚餐点了猪排和蔬菜沙拉。
ex.note: a pork chop 猪排；a lamb chop 羊排

ex.en: A clerk at the counter showed them the price list.
ex.cn: 柜台的一名职员给他们看了价目表。
ex.note: a bank clerk 银行职员；a shop clerk 店员

ex.en: The dog pulled hard against the leather collar.
ex.cn: 那条狗用力拽着皮项圈。
ex.note: a dog collar 狗项圈；a shirt collar 衣领

ex.en: There was no radio communication with the campus that morning.
ex.cn: 那天早上他们和校园之间没有无线电联络。
ex.note: communication with 与…的交流/通讯；a communication system 通信系统

ex.en: The engineers computed the cost of the new bridge in three days.
ex.cn: 工程师们三天就算出了新桥的造价。
ex.note: compute sth. 计算某物

ex.en: The two events took place in conjunction with the sports meeting.
ex.cn: 这两件事是与运动会同时进行的。
ex.note: in conjunction with 与…同时/结合

ex.en: The remaining equipment arrived in a steel container.
ex.cn: 剩下的设备是装在一只钢制集装箱里运来的。
ex.note: a shipping container 集装箱；a plastic container 塑料容器

ex.en: A loose copper wire kept touching the bottom of the switch.
ex.cn: 一根松脱的铜线一直碰到开关的底部。
ex.note: copper wire 铜线；a copper coin 一枚铜币

ex.en: The course runs around the track twice before it climbs the hill.
ex.cn: 这条赛道先绕操场跑两圈，然后才爬上山。
ex.note: of course 当然；a course of action 行动方案；a main course 主菜

ex.en: A good crop of wheat came in that autumn.
ex.cn: 那年秋天小麦收成不错。
ex.note: a good/bad crop 好年景/歉收

ex.en: The farmers cropped the field a week earlier than usual.
ex.cn: 农民们比往年早一周收割了田地。
ex.note: crop up（问题）冒出来

ex.en: Every customer at the sale bought something to carry home.
ex.cn: 义卖上每个顾客都买了点什么带回家。
ex.note: a regular customer 老主顾；customer service 客户服务

ex.en: The cameras were too dear for a student club to afford.
ex.cn: 这些相机太贵，学生社团买不起。
ex.note: dear at the price 价格昂贵的；dear to sb. 亲爱的

ex.en: "Dear me, what a mess this office is in!"
ex.cn: “天哪，这办公室乱成什么样子了！”
ex.note: Dear me! 哎呀！；oh dear 哎呀

ex.en: Each technical term in the handbook has a clear definition.
ex.cn: 手册里每个专业术语都有清楚的定义。
ex.note: by definition 按定义

ex.en: The clerk gave a detailed description of the new models.
ex.cn: 职员详细描述了那些新型号。
ex.note: a detailed description of … 对…的详细描述

ex.en: Measure the diameter of the balloon before you fill it.
ex.cn: 在气球充气之前先量一量它的直径。
ex.note: ten centimetres in diameter 直径十厘米

ex.en: The main disadvantage of the old track is that it gets muddy.
ex.cn: 这条老跑道的主要缺点是容易变泥泞。
ex.note: a disadvantage of … …的缺点；at a disadvantage 处于不利地位

ex.en: There was a distinct smell of rain in the air that morning.
ex.cn: 那天早上空气里有一股明显的雨腥味。
ex.note: distinct from 与…不同；a distinct advantage 明显的好处

ex.en: David stood at the door of the office, watching the sky.
ex.cn: 大卫站在办公室门口，看着天空。
ex.note: at the door of 在…门口；out of doors 在户外

ex.en: The temperature dropped sharply after midnight.
ex.cn: 午夜过后气温骤降。
ex.note: drop by 下降；drop prices 降价；drop a line 写封信

ex.en: A single drop of blood fell onto the white page.
ex.cn: 一滴血落在那页白纸上。
ex.note: a drop of 一滴；a drop in the ocean 九牛一毛

ex.en: He finished the long race with ease.
ex.cn: 他轻松跑完了这段长距离。
ex.note: with ease 轻松地；at ease 自在；for ease 为了方便

ex.en: The medicine eased the pain in her knee.
ex.cn: 这药缓解了她膝盖的疼痛。
ex.note: ease the pain 缓解疼痛；ease off 缓和下来

ex.en: The nurse wrapped the injured knee in an elastic bandage.
ex.cn: 护士用弹力绷带把受伤的膝盖缠了起来。
ex.note: elastic band 橡皮筋；elastic rule 弹性原则

ex.en: The teacher put emphasis on the last two words of the question.
ex.cn: 老师强调了这个问题的最后两个字。
ex.note: put/lay emphasis on 强调

ex.en: Starting a small business was a real enterprise for the two of them.
ex.cn: 对他们两个来说，开一家小店是件真正的事业。
ex.note: a private enterprise 私营企业；show enterprise 有进取心

ex.en: The coach came every week to evaluate the runners' progress.
ex.cn: 教练每周都来评估选手们的进展。
ex.note: evaluate the results/effect 评估结果/效果

ex.en: Excessive training can do more harm than good.
ex.cn: 过量的训练弊大于利。
ex.note: excessive use of 过度使用；excessive speed 速度过快

ex.en: The groundskeeper had an explosive temper and shouted at everyone.
ex.cn: 那位场地管理员脾气火爆，对谁都要吼。
ex.note: an explosive temper 火爆的脾气；explosive growth 爆炸性增长

ex.en: The police found a bag of explosives in the empty warehouse.
ex.cn: 警方在空仓库里发现了一袋炸药。
ex.note: a bag of explosives 一袋炸药

ex.en: Despite the setbacks, she kept her faith in the team.
ex.cn: 尽管一再受挫，她仍对这支队伍抱有信心。
ex.note: have faith in 对…有信心；in good faith 诚心诚意地

ex.en: The microphone was faulty, so the recording had to be done again.
ex.cn: 麦克风有毛病，录音只好重做一遍。
ex.note: faulty equipment 有故障的设备；a faulty argument 站不住脚的论点

ex.en: Fifteen hundred students entered the sports meeting this year.
ex.cn: 今年有一千五百名学生参加了运动会。
ex.note: fifteen hundred 一千五百

ex.en: The road was flat and easy to run on.
ex.cn: 这条路平坦，很好跑。
ex.note: a flat surface 平坦的表面；a flat tyre 瘪了的轮胎

ex.en: They rented a small flat near the college.
ex.cn: 他们在学院附近租了一间小公寓。
ex.note: a one-bedroom flat 一居室

ex.en: He plays football for the university team every week.
ex.cn: 他每周都替大学队踢足球。
ex.note: play football 踢足球；a football match 一场足球赛

ex.en: Four laps of the track are enough for a warm-up.
ex.cn: 绕跑道四圈热身就够了。
ex.note: four times 四次

ex.en: The club fulfilled every promise it had made to the students.
ex.cn: 俱乐部兑现了它对学生许下的每一个诺言。
ex.note: fulfill a promise 兑现承诺；fulfill one's duty 履行职责

ex.en: A crowd gathered in the square before the race began.
ex.cn: 比赛开始前，人群聚集在广场上。
ex.note: gather speed 加速；gather one's thoughts 镇定下来

ex.en: It was a glorious morning, clear and cold.
ex.cn: 那是个辉煌的早晨，天朗气清，微寒。
ex.note: a glorious victory 辉煌的胜利

ex.en: The label says the jar contains only two hundred grams of jam.
ex.cn: 标签上写着这一罐只有两百克果酱。
ex.note: a hundred grams 一百克

ex.en: The body needs time for growth, especially in young athletes.
ex.cn: 身体需要时间才能成长，年轻的运动员尤其如此。
ex.note: economic growth 经济增长；a growth in … …的增长

ex.en: It is handy to keep a spare battery in your bag.
ex.cn: 在包里备一节备用电池是很方便的。
ex.note: come in handy 派上用场；handy for 对…很方便

ex.en: A healthy body needs rest as much as exercise.
ex.cn: 健康的身体需要休息，就像需要锻炼一样。
ex.note: a healthy diet 健康饮食；healthy growth 健康成长

ex.en: The wall along the track is too high to see over.
ex.cn: 跑道边的墙太高，看不过去。
ex.note: a high price 高价；high standards 高标准

ex.en: The horse jumped high over the fence.
ex.cn: 那匹马高高地跃过了篱笆。
ex.note: high above 高悬于；high above the city 高踞城市之上

ex.en: There is hope that the weather will be fine on race day.
ex.cn: 有希望比赛那天天气会好。
ex.note: hope for 希望…；in the hope of 抱着…的希望

ex.en: The boy was hungry and had not eaten since morning.
ex.cn: 那男孩饿了，从早上起就没吃过东西。
ex.note: be hungry for 渴望；hungry for knowledge 求知若渴

ex.en: Children imitate what they see their parents do.
ex.cn: 孩子会模仿他们看到父母做的事。
ex.note: imitate sb. 模仿某人

ex.en: It is increasingly difficult to find a quiet place on campus.
ex.cn: 在校园里找一个安静的地方越来越难了。
ex.note: increasingly difficult 越来越困难

ex.en: She took the initiative and organized the sale herself.
ex.cn: 她主动挑起了这件事，亲自把义卖组织起来。
ex.note: take the initiative 主动出击；on one's own initiative 凭自己的主动性

ex.en: They insured the whole shipment before the truck left the port.
ex.cn: 卡车驶离港口前，他们为整批货物投了保。
ex.note: insure sth. against fire 给…投保火险；insure sb. 保险

ex.en: The university promised to investigate the theft and report back.
ex.cn: 校方承诺会调查这桩盗窃并给出答复。
ex.note: investigate a case 调查案件

ex.en: He had injured a joint in his knee during the race.
ex.cn: 比赛中他伤到了膝盖的一个关节。
ex.note: a joint in the finger 手指关节；out of joint 脱臼

ex.en: The two clubs made a joint decision to share the equipment.
ex.cn: 两个俱乐部联合决定共用这批器材。
ex.note: joint effort 共同努力；joint responsibility 共同责任

ex.en: A kindergarten teacher told them that children imitate everything they see.
ex.cn: 一位幼儿园老师告诉他们，孩子会模仿他们看到的一切。
ex.note: go to kindergarten 上幼儿园

ex.en: He ran four laps of the track before the race even began.
ex.cn: 比赛还没开始，他已经绕跑道跑了四圈。
ex.note: the last lap 最后一圈；on your lap 轮到你

ex.en: A learned professor agreed to be interviewed on the radio.
ex.cn: 一位有学问的教授同意接受电台采访。
ex.note: a learned man 博学的人；a learned society 学术团体

ex.en: His university life began in September and reached its high point in the spring meet.
ex.cn: 他的大学生活从九月开始，在春季运动会时达到了高点。
ex.note: a lifelong friend 终身的朋友；for life 终身

ex.en: The sports club was happy to loan them six hurdles for the day.
ex.cn: 体育俱乐部很乐意借给他们六副跨栏架用一天。
ex.note: take out a loan 贷款；on loan 借用的

ex.en: The club loaned the school a set of timing clocks for the term.
ex.cn: 俱乐部借给学校一套计时钟，用一个学期。
ex.note: loan sth. to sb. 把某物借给某人

ex.en: We were lucky that the rain held off until the race was over.
ex.cn: 我们运气好，雨一直等到比赛结束才下起来。
ex.note: be lucky to do 幸运地做成某事；a lucky break 一次好运

ex.en: The manager of the agency added one more condition to the contract.
ex.cn: 经销处的经理在合同上又加了一个条件。
ex.note: office manager 办公室经理；branch manager 分部经理

ex.en: Maybe we should hold the sale on Saturday instead.
ex.cn: 也许我们该把义卖改到星期六。
ex.note: maybe not 也许不；as maybe 说不定

ex.en: The guard showed mercy and did not report the boy to the police.
ex.cn: 保安手下留情，没有把这男孩报告给警方。
ex.note: show mercy to sb. 对某人手下留情；without mercy 毫不留情

ex.en: Twenty minus four is sixteen.
ex.cn: 二十减四是十六。
ex.note: A minus B A减B；plus … 加

ex.en: On a night of minus ten degrees, the water froze solid.
ex.cn: 零下十度的夜里，水结得结结实实。
ex.note: minus ten degrees 零下十度

ex.en: A stone monument stands in the middle of the square.
ex.cn: 广场中央立着一座石碑。
ex.note: a monument to sb. 纪念某人的纪念碑

ex.en: His muscles were still sore three days after the race.
ex.cn: 比赛三天后，他的肌肉仍然酸痛。
ex.note: muscle power 肌肉力量；a muscle in the arm 手臂上的一块肌肉

ex.en: A longer course is not necessarily a harder one.
ex.cn: 更长的赛道未必就更难。
ex.note: not necessarily 未必

ex.en: Nine runners started the race, and only six finished it.
ex.cn: 九名选手起跑，只有六人跑完了全程。
ex.note: nine tenths 九成

ex.en: He had been training for the race since November.
ex.cn: 他从十一月起就一直在为这场比赛训练。
ex.note: in November 在十一月

ex.en: The whole occurrence was reported in the college paper.
ex.cn: 整件事都登在了校报上。
ex.note: a rare occurrence 罕见的事件

ex.en: They tested the operation of the timing system twice.
ex.cn: 他们把计时系统的运转测试了两遍。
ex.note: a minor operation 小手术；in operation 运转中

ex.en: We found ourselves sitting in the rain at midnight.
ex.cn: 我们发现自己午夜时分还坐在雨里。
ex.note: by ourselves 独自；help ourselves to 随便吃

ex.en: They packed the equipment into boxes and tied them with rope.
ex.cn: 他们把器材装进箱子，用绳子捆好。
ex.note: pack a suitcase 收拾行李

ex.en: A pack of wolves was seen near the edge of the forest.
ex.cn: 有人在森林边缘看见了一群狼。
ex.note: a pack of 一群（狼、卡片等）

ex.en: Every participant received a small medal at the closing ceremony.
ex.cn: 每位参赛者在闭幕式上都得到了一枚小奖牌。
ex.note: an active participant 积极参与者

ex.en: They reached the peak of the hill just before noon.
ex.cn: 他们在中午前不久登上了山顶。
ex.note: at the peak of … 在…顶峰

ex.en: Ticket sales reached a peak during the summer holiday.
ex.cn: 暑假的票务销售达到了峰值。
ex.note: peak sales/period 销售高峰/高峰期

ex.en: Personally, I think the plan needs more time.
ex.cn: 就我个人而言，我觉得这个计划还需要更多时间。
ex.note: personally speaking 就个人而言

ex.en: He put a pillow under his leg to keep it raised.
ex.cn: 他在腿下垫了个枕头，把腿抬高。
ex.note: a pillow under the head 头下的枕头

ex.en: The plural of 'child' is 'children'.
ex.cn: child 的复数形式是 children。
ex.note: in the plural 用复数形式

ex.en: Is 'data' a plural word or a singular one?
ex.cn: data 是复数词还是单数词？
ex.note: a plural noun 复数名词

ex.en: A cargo ship was unloading at the port when they arrived.
ex.cn: 他们到的时候，一艘货船正在港口卸货。
ex.note: at the port 在港口；a free port 自由港

ex.en: The coach praised the runners for finishing the race at all.
ex.cn: 教练称赞了选手们能坚持跑完全程。
ex.note: praise sb. for 因某事赞扬某人；in praise of 赞美

ex.en: Our primary concern is the safety of the runners.
ex.cn: 我们首要关心的是选手们的安全。
ex.note: primary school 小学；of primary importance 首要的

ex.en: The radio program about sport was broadcast on Friday morning.
ex.cn: 那期关于运动的广播节目在星期五上午播出。
ex.note: a radio program 广播节目；an exchange program 交流项目

ex.en: She programmed the computer to print the results at eight.
ex.cn: 她给电脑编了程序，让它在八点打印结果。
ex.note: program a computer 给电脑编程

ex.en: The psychology of sport was the subject of her weekly radio program.
ex.cn: 运动心理学是她每周广播节目的主题。
ex.note: child psychology 儿童心理学

ex.en: Nobody could answer his question about the missing money.
ex.cn: 关于丢失的钱，没有谁能回答他的问题。
ex.note: a question of … 一个…的问题；out of the question 不可能

ex.en: No one questioned the decision of the committee.
ex.cn: 没有人质疑委员会的决定。
ex.note: question sb. about sth. 就某事质问某人

ex.en: The ratio of speed to endurance decides who wins a long race.
ex.cn: 速度与耐力的比例决定了谁能赢下长跑。
ex.note: the ratio of A to B A与B的比例

ex.en: The doctor recommended rest for a week after the injury.
ex.cn: 医生建议受伤后休息一周。
ex.note: recommend sb. for sth. 推荐某人做某事

ex.en: Every participant had to follow the regulations of the meet.
ex.cn: 每位参赛者都必须遵守运动会的规章。
ex.note: safety regulations 安全规定；under regulation 受管理

ex.en: Could you repeat the last question, please?
ex.cn: 请把最后一个问题再说一遍好吗？
ex.note: repeat oneself 再说一遍；a repeat performance 重复演出

ex.en: The runners took their respective places on the starting line.
ex.cn: 选手们各就各位，站到了起跑线上。
ex.note: in their respective … 各自在…；respective to 相应的

ex.en: The road climbed along a narrow ridge above the bay.
ex.cn: 这条路沿着海湾上方一道狭窄的山脊爬上去。
ex.note: a mountain ridge 山脊；the ridge of a roof 屋脊

ex.en: The table has a round top and three legs.
ex.cn: 这张桌子有一个圆桌面和三条腿。
ex.note: a round face 圆脸；round numbers 整数

ex.en: The children sat round the fire and told stories.
ex.cn: 孩子们围坐在火堆旁讲故事。
ex.note: all year round 全年；go round 绕道

ex.en: Each round of the match lasted twenty minutes.
ex.cn: 每一轮比赛都持续二十分钟。
ex.note: in the first round 在第一轮；a round of applause 一阵掌声

ex.en: The charity sale in the square raised enough money for the equipment.
ex.cn: 广场上的义卖筹够了买器材的钱。
ex.note: on sale 出售；for sale 待售；a sale on 打折出售

ex.en: The schedule of the sports meeting was posted this morning.
ex.cn: 运动会的日程表今天早上贴了出来。
ex.note: on schedule 按计划；ahead of schedule 提前

ex.en: The meet is scheduled to open on Friday at nine.
ex.cn: 运动会定于星期五上午九点开幕。
ex.note: be scheduled for 预定在

ex.en: The doors of the storehouse were secure and could not be forced.
ex.cn: 仓库的门很结实，撬不开。
ex.note: be secure from 免受；in a secure position 处于安全的位置

ex.en: She secured a place for herself at the training camp.
ex.cn: 她在训练营里给自己争取到了一个名额。
ex.note: secure a place/loan 获得名额/贷款

ex.en: He set the heavy box down on the floor.
ex.cn: 他把那个沉重的箱子放在了地上。
ex.note: set up 搭建；set off 出发

ex.en: A set of keys lay on the table by the door.
ex.cn: 门边桌上放着一串钥匙。
ex.note: a set of 一套；a complete set 全套

ex.en: The coach gave the runners a set routine for every morning.
ex.cn: 教练给选手们定了一套每天早晨的固定流程。
ex.note: a set routine 固定的流程；a set example 典型的例子

ex.en: A large cargo ship was unloading beside the wharf.
ex.cn: 一艘大型货船正在码头旁卸货。
ex.note: on board ship 在船上

ex.en: They shipped the equipment to the port warehouse that afternoon.
ex.cn: 那天下午他们把器材运到了港口仓库。
ex.note: ship goods 装运货物；ship out 运出

ex.en: The significance of the meet was not the medals but the people.
ex.cn: 这届运动会的意义不在奖牌，而在人。
ex.note: of great significance 意义重大

ex.en: Skill matters less than patience in a long race.
ex.cn: 在长跑中，技巧远不如耐心重要。
ex.note: a high level of skill 高超的技艺；skill in doing 做某事的技巧

ex.en: The last snow of winter melted within two days.
ex.cn: 冬天的最后一场雪两天就化了。
ex.note: a heavy fall of snow 大雪

ex.en: It snowed heavily on the mountains that night.
ex.cn: 那天夜里山上下起了大雪。
ex.note: be snowed under 被雪压住

ex.en: Their son was studying medicine in another city.
ex.cn: 他们的儿子在另一座城市学医。
ex.note: a son of a bitch 混账（粗话）

ex.en: The contract specified the date on which the goods must be collected.
ex.cn: 合同明确规定了货物必须提走的日期。
ex.note: specify the date 明确规定日期

ex.en: A crowd gathered in the square beside the monument.
ex.cn: 人群聚集在纪念碑旁的广场上。
ex.note: in the square 在广场上；a square kilometre 一平方公里

ex.en: She drew a square on the paper and wrote four numbers inside it.
ex.cn: 她在纸上画了个正方形，在里面写了四个数字。
ex.note: a square meal 一顿丰盛的饭；square face 方形脸

ex.en: The path up the hill was too steep for the old wagon.
ex.cn: 上山的路对那辆旧货车来说太陡了。
ex.note: steep hills 陡坡；a steep rise 急剧上升

ex.en: She made jam from strawberries picked in the hills.
ex.cn: 她用山里采的草莓熬了果酱。
ex.note: a strawberry field 草莓田

ex.en: They took the subway into the city because it was cheaper.
ex.cn: 他们乘地铁进城，因为那样更省钱。
ex.note: by subway 乘地铁；subway station 地铁站

ex.en: This camera is superior to the one they had used before.
ex.cn: 这台相机比他们原先用的那台好。
ex.note: superior to 比…好；superior quality 上乘的质量

ex.en: In mathematics nobody in the class was his superior.
ex.cn: 在数学上，班上没人比他强。
ex.note: be superior to sb. 比某人强；a superior officer 上级军官

ex.en: Her ankle began to swell a few minutes after the fall.
ex.cn: 摔倒几分钟后，她的脚踝开始肿起来。
ex.note: swell up 肿起来；a swelling tide 涨潮

ex.en: They took a taxi back to the campus that evening.
ex.cn: 那天傍晚他们打车回了校园。
ex.note: take/catch a taxi 打车；a taxi rank 出租车候车处

ex.en: The bus terminal near the port was crowded with people.
ex.cn: 港口附近的长途汽车总站挤满了人。
ex.note: an airport terminal 航站楼；a terminal station 终点站

ex.en: The doctor said the illness was terminal and incurable.
ex.cn: 医生说这种病是绝症，无法治愈。
ex.note: terminal cancer 晚期癌症；terminal stage 末期

ex.en: The thief was caught within a minute of the theft.
ex.cn: 那个小偷在案发一分钟后就被抓住了。
ex.note: a thief in the night 窃贼

ex.en: Put a tick beside each answer to show that you have checked it.
ex.cn: 在每个答案旁打一个勾，表示你已核对过。
ex.note: a tick in the box 打勾；in a tick 一会儿

ex.en: She ticked each item off the list as she finished it.
ex.cn: 她每做完一项就在清单上打一个勾。
ex.note: tick off 勾掉；tick sb. off 训斥某人

ex.en: The warehouse charges storage by the ton after the first three days.
ex.cn: 三天之后，仓库按吨收取仓储费。
ex.note: tons of 大量；a ton of 一吨

ex.en: His training for the eight hundred metres began in November.
ex.cn: 他为八百米所做的训练从十一月就开始了。
ex.note: a training programme 训练计划；in training 在训练中

ex.en: The shop sold tropical fruit from the south.
ex.cn: 那家店卖的是来自南方的热带水果。
ex.note: tropical fruit 热带水果；a tropical climate 热带气候

ex.en: She bought an umbrella for her son before the rainy season.
ex.cn: 雨季到来之前，她给儿子买了把伞。
ex.note: an umbrella policy 全面（无限制）的政策

ex.en: Wait until the rain stops before you leave.
ex.cn: 等雨停了再走。
ex.note: not … until … 直到…才…

ex.en: The discount is valid only until Friday.
ex.cn: 这个折扣只到星期五有效。
ex.note: be valid for 有效期为；a valid reason 站得住脚的理由

ex.en: He mixed the salad with oil and a little vinegar.
ex.cn: 他用油和少许醋调了沙拉汁。
ex.note: a spoonful of vinegar 一勺醋

ex.en: They borrowed the groundskeeper's old station wagon.
ex.cn: 他们借来了场地管理员那辆旧旅行车。
ex.note: a station wagon 旅行车；a covered wagon 篷车

ex.en: The weather turned cold and windy just before the race.
ex.cn: 比赛前夕，天气变得又冷又有风。
ex.note: weather permitting 天气允许的话；under the weather 身体不适

ex.en: Wherever you go, I will keep in touch.
ex.cn: 无论你去哪里，我都会保持联系。
ex.note: wherever possible 尽可能；wherever you are 无论你在哪里

ex.en: The last snow of winter fell in early March.
ex.cn: 冬天的最后一场雪在三月初落下。
ex.note: in winter 在冬天；winter sports 冬季运动

ex.en: That was the worst winter the town had seen in forty years.
ex.cn: 那是这个镇四十年来最糟的冬天。
ex.note: the worst of … …中最糟的；do one's worst 尽力

ex.en: Is this umbrella yours, or did you bring two?
ex.cn: 这把伞是你的吗，还是你带了两把？
ex.note: yours truly 您的忠实仆人（信末用语）
